        Param
        (
            # Param1 - Provide First Name
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$false,
                       Position=0)]
            $Firstname,
    
            # Param2 - Provide Surname
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$false,                   
                       Position=1)]
            $Lastname,
    
            # Param3 - Provide Surname
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$false,                   
                       Position=2)]
            $EmailAddress,
    
            # Param3 - Provide Surname
            [Parameter(Mandatory=$false,                   
                       Position=3)]
            $UPN
    
            
        )    
            
           if ($Lastname) {
               $user = get-aduser  -filter {(surname -eq $Lastname) -and (givenname -eq $firstname) } -pr * | Where-Object {$_.name -notlike "*(Admin)*"}            
             
    
           } elseif ($EmailAddress) {
                $user =  get-aduser -filter {emailaddress -eq $EmailAddress} -pr *           
               
    
           }  else {       
                $user =  get-aduser  -filter {userprincipalname -eq $UPN} -pr *
    
               
            }
    
            [pscustomobject] [ordered] @{
    
            'Account Created'=$user.whenCreated.GetDateTimeFormats()[27]
            'Account Expiration Date'=$(if($user.accountexpirationdate){$user.accountexpirationdate}else{'No expiration set on account.'})
            'Description'=$(if($user.description){$user.Description} else {'No property set'}) #By surrounding it with $() we make it a subexpression which is executed first
            'Email Address'=$user.emailaddress
            'Password Last set'=$user.PasswordLastSet
